displayName: OCI-WSTG10-002: Business Logic — Rate Limit Bypass
description:
Detects API rate limit bypass attempts using header manipulation, IP rotation, or parameter tampering

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%business%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%logic%') AND "value" > 0
